description: Show the account's billing status: plan (free_trial, pay_as_you_go, pro or custom), creditsRemaining, renewsAt, trialEndsAt, pendingPayment and canManageBilling. Read-only and free to call. Use it to tell the user before an upload, analysis or chat would run past the remaining credits, or after a tool reports that the account cannot cover the work. Retry a blocked tool only after the user confirms their account has credits.
